title: Generic constancy of a subsheaf of a constant finite sheaf
statement: Let $W$ be a nonempty irreducible scheme with generic point $\eta$, let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, let $M$ be a finite $\Lambda$-module, and let $\underline M$ be the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site $W_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. If $H\subset\underline M$ is a subsheaf of $\Lambda$-modules, then there are a nonempty open subset $W^\circ\subset W$ and a $\Lambda$-submodule $M'\subset M$ such that $H|_{W^\circ}=\underline{M'}$ as subsheaves of $\underline M|_{W^\circ}$.
